QuestInfo.name: [Detective Rave's Case Notes] Girl from Another Star
QuestInfo.0:
You arrived at Savage Terminal! How about that smell, huh?
The robot you thought would greet you launched a missile instead. Then you got mobbed by angry people and ended up at the #bLuxury Tour Agency#k.

You decide to start by talking to #bToole#k, supposedly the CEO.
QuestInfo.1: They tried to shift the blame on you, but you weren't having it. Then, the Luxury Tour Agent attacked you. Now that you've defeated them all, you decide to talk to the CEO #bToole#k located in the #bLuxury Tour Agency#k.
QuestInfo.2:
The situation started to unravel with the appearance of a girl named Senya. Now you have to look for the cargo she was transporting. 

Talk to #bLuxury Tour Agency Staff#k in #bBrigand's Row#k.
